obsPluginLive.setup: OBS 32 plugin on the same Mac, live camera at ~25 fps with no card in view, so only segmentation ran; scan.ms over 120 s per backend, camera video effects off. Percentiles, not means: the point of the capture is the shape over time.

runs.note: Same reverted patch as the offline GPU row.

summary: Offline the Neural Engine wins by a wide margin: 3.5 ms per frame against 16.8 on the GPU and 26.3 on the CPU provider, all fp16.
Inside OBS the Neural Engine path ramps from 4 to 25 ms on a ~70 s cycle (p50 15.5); CPUAndGPU is flat at 8.9 ms.

On the one Windows machine benchmarked twice, fp16 plus the 5670390 code and ONNX Runtime changes took a scan from 28.3 to 14.3 ms. A control run isolating the models puts 8.3 ms of that on code and runtime and 5.7 ms on fp16 itself.
